title: Agentic AI for Safety-critical Multi-drone Systems: Challenges and Opportunities
abstract: arXiv:2608.21444v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-drone systems are increasingly positioned for safety-critical missions such as search and rescue (SAR) and critical infrastructure monitoring. Yet, real-world adoption remains constrained not only by autonomy performance, but by the difficulty of integrating agentic behavior into professional work: operators must understand, trust, and govern automation under uncertainty, time pressure, and accountability. This position paper synthesizes the ambitions and lessons from two ongoing efforts: NAMUR, which explores LLM-supported robot control in SAR and firefighting contexts, and PERSIST, which explores persistent drone operations for monitoring and security at critical infrastructure sites. We argue that agentic AI should be approached as a socio-technical design problem, where interfaces, oversight mechanisms, and evaluation practices are as critical as algorithms. We outline a human-centered, participatory, and iterative research app

translated_title: 面向安全关键多无人机系统的代理型人工智能：挑战与机遇
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21444v1 公告类型：新 摘要：多无人机系统日益被定位用于安全关键任务，如搜索与救援（SAR）和关键基础设施监测。然而，实际应用仍受限于不仅包括自主性能，还包括将代理行为整合到专业工作中的困难：操作员必须在不确定性、时间压力和问责制下理解、信任并管理自动化。本文立场文件综合了两项正在进行的工作的雄心和经验教训：NAMUR，探索在SAR和消防场景中支持LLM的机器人控制；以及PERSIST，探索在关键基础设施站点进行持续监测和安全的无人机操作。我们认为，代理型人工智能应被视为一个社会技术设计问题，其中界面、监督机制和评估实践与算法同样关键。我们概述了一个以人为中心、参与式和迭代式的研究方向。
tldr: 本文主张将代理型人工智能在多无人机系统中的应用视为社会技术设计问题，强调人机界面、监督机制和评估实践与算法同等重要，并基于NAMUR和PERSIST两个项目提出以人为中心的迭代研究方向。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that agentic AI in multi-drone systems should be treated as a socio-technical design problem, emphasizing that interfaces, oversight mechanisms, and evaluation practices are as critical as algorithms, and proposes a human-centered, participatory, and iterative research agenda based on the NAMUR and PERSIST projects.
